signOutError: Could not sign out. Please try again.
passkeyCancelled: Request cancelled. Try again whenever you like.
passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Update it or use another one.
passkeyDuplicate: This passkey is already registered on this account.
passkeyUnauthorized: Passkey or invite not recognised. An invite lasts 15 minutes and works once.
passkeyTooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
passkeyFailed: Could not finish with the passkey. Please try again.

invite.title: Create your access
invite.explain: Choose how you will sign in: with a password or with a passkey. wordloop keeps only an irreversible fingerprint of the password, never the password itself.
invite.invalid: This invite link is not valid or was already used. Ask whoever runs wordloop for a new one.
invite.savedWithoutSession: Password set. This account requires 2 factors, so sign in with your passkey.

passkeys.title: My passkeys
passkeys.intro: These are the passwordless ways to sign in to this site.
passkeys.lastOne: This is the only way to sign in to the account: it cannot be deleted.
passkeys.loadFailed: Could not load your passkeys. Sign in again or try later.
passkeys.deleteFailed: Could not delete. Please try again.
passkeys.signInFirst: Sign in to see your passkeys.

brand.headline: Really learn English,
brand.text: Spaced-repetition vocabulary that adapts to what you already know, at your pace and on your phone.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in with your e-mail and password.

errors.failed: Could not sign in with the provider. Please try again.
errors.twoFactor: This account requires 2 factors and the provider did not prove them. Sign in with the passkey.
errors.email: The provider did not report a confirmed e-mail. Confirm it there and try again, or sign in with e-mail and password.

signup.title: Create account
signup.intro: Enter your e-mail: we will send a link to confirm it and choose your password.
signup.sent: We sent a link to {{email}}. It is valid for 24 hours. Check your spam folder too.

password.twoFactor: This account requires 2 factors. Sign in with the passkey.
password.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
password.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
password.weak: Weak password: use 12 to 128 characters, different from the e-mail and not one repeated character.
password.inviteInvalid: The link is no longer valid (it expired or was already used). Ask for a new one.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter the account e-mail and we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, we sent a link to choose a new password. It is valid for 30 minutes. Check your spam folder too.

verify.title: Confirm your e-mail
verify.explain: Choose your account password to finish signing up.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.explain: Choose the new password. Other signed-in devices will be signed out.

link.invalid: This link is not valid, has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

email.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
email.unavailable: Sending e-mails is not available in this environment.
email.failed: Could not send right now. Please try again.
